description: Machine-readable index of diagnoses. Match on signal+match, never on user wording alone.

entries.title: Windows Update fails with 0x800f0922 / CBS_E_SOURCE_MODIFIED
symptoms: boot takes much longer than usual
distinguishFrom: Real boot failure: would show Kernel-Power 41 or BugCheck 1001.
Disk full on System Reserved: check volumes.systemReservedFreeMB.
entries.reversible: SoftwareDistribution and catroot2 are renamed to .old, not deleted. Restore by stopping the services and renaming back.
entries.notes: DISM and SFC saturate disk I/O. Warn the user the machine will feel frozen while they run.

entries.title: A PowerShell window opens at every logon
symptoms: a terminal opens when I log in
distinguishFrom: A terminal app (Windows Terminal, Warp, Hyper) started from a registry Run key: check runKeys in the report; the fix there is removing the Run entry.
entries.reversible: Set the task principal back to LogonType Interactive.
entries.notes: lastTaskResult 3221225786 is 0xC000013A (STATUS_CONTROL_C_EXIT) - the user closed the window and killed the script. S4U fixes both the window and the silent death.

entries.title: WHEA-Logger 17 PCIe correctable errors behind random freezes
symptoms: system freezes for a few seconds
random stutters with no blue screen
mouse and audio stall then recover
distinguishFrom: I/O saturation from a running repair or antivirus scan: check processes.tiWorkerCpuSeconds and processes.avCpuTop.
Storage problems: check storage.errorEvents and storage.healthStatus.
entries.reversible: Diagnosis only. Driver, firmware and ASPM changes are performed by the human.
entries.notes: Correlate WHEA timestamps against the reported freeze time. A high count with no timestamp match is a separate chronic issue, not the cause of the acute event. Report it as such.

entries.title: Antivirus exclusion applies to the wrong protection components
symptoms: I already added the exclusion and nothing changed
builds still slow after excluding the folder
update still fails with antivirus exclusion in place
distinguishFrom: Trusted-application entry pointing at a stale path after a tool update: check antivirus.trustedAppsMissingOnDisk.
entries.reversible: Keep the pre-change configuration export; import restores it.
entries.notes: An exclusion scoped only to behaviour detection leaves the real-time file scanner active. Parse the stored component list; do not trust the UI summary.

entries.title: Trusted-application rule points at a path that no longer exists
symptoms: tool worked before the update and now gets blocked
app cannot write to the hosts file
distinguishFrom: Genuine permission problem: check whether the hosts file is read-only and whether the process elevates.
entries.reversible: Remove the added entry, or restore the configuration backup.
entries.notes: Trusted-app rules match on exact executable path. When a tool relocates its binary the rule silently stops matching. Register the elevation helper too, not only the main binary.
